items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Sy Oliver is supposed to have written the whole thing.

ctx.x: Yeah. He wrote an awful lot of arrangements that he didn't get credit for. Sy Oliver is supposed to have written the whole thing. No. Eddie Wilcox wrote an awful lot of that stuff, like "Sleepy Time Gal," you know, with that double time...
